description:
Probe and report SAP system capabilities. Use BEFORE operations that depend on optional features (abapGit, RAP/CDS, AMDP, HANA, UI5/Fiori, CTS transports, FLP). Also handles package (DEVC) lifecycle.

Actions:
- "features": cached feature status (fast, no round-trip; id, available, mode, probedAt). "probe": re-probe now (feature probes + auth + discovery refresh). "cache_stats": object cache health.
- "create_package" / "delete_package" / "change_package": DEVC lifecycle via ADT packages API.
- FLP read: flp_list_catalogs, flp_list_groups, flp_list_tiles (catalogId). FLP write: flp_create_catalog, flp_create_group, flp_create_tile, flp_add_tile_to_group, flp_delete_catalog. Classic designer tile/target-mapping model, deprecated since S/4HANA 2023; Work Zone exposure v2 needs LADIs (SAPRead type=UIAD).
- "set_api_state": release/revoke an object's API release contract (objectUri, or name+objectType; apiState defaults RELEASED, contract defaults C1 — C0 for SRVD, C3 for classic views). Write counterpart of SAPRead(type="API_STATE").

Returns features + systemType ("onprem"/"btp"); "available: false" means do NOT attempt dependent operations.

action.description: Action to execute. Read actions: features, probe, cache_stats, flp_list_catalogs, flp_list_groups, flp_list_tiles. Mutating package/FLP actions require writable safety config and write scope in authenticated mode.

apiState.description: For set_api_state: target state of the object's API release contract — RELEASED (mark released for ABAP Cloud / Clean Core) or NOT_RELEASED (revoke). Default RELEASED. Visibility (ABAP Cloud / Key User Apps) follows the contract's defaults. Read the current state first with SAPRead(type="API_STATE").

catalogId.description: FLP catalog identifier — accepts either full ID (X-SAP-UI2-CATALOGPAGE:MY_CAT) or domain ID (MY_CAT). Required for flp_list_tiles, flp_create_tile, flp_add_tile_to_group, flp_delete_catalog.

contract.description: For set_api_state: which release contract to set. Default C1 (Key-User/Cloud — the common clean-core contract). Object types support different contracts: e.g. service definitions (SRVD) only support C0, classic DDIC views only C3, behavior definitions and tables support C0+C1. If the object does not support the chosen contract, the error lists the ones it does.

domainId.description: Domain ID — required for flp_create_catalog (e.g., ZARC1_SALES).

groupId.description: FLP group/page identifier (required for flp_create_group, flp_add_tile_to_group).

name.description: Package name (required for create_package and delete_package).

newPackage.description: Target package to move the object to. Required for change_package.

objectName.description: Object name to move (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS). Required for change_package.

objectType.description: ADT object type (e.g., CLAS/OC, DDLS/DF, PROG/P). Required for change_package. For set_api_state: object type of "name" when objectUri is omitted (e.g. CLAS, INTF, DDLS, TABL).

objectUri.description: ADT URI of the object to move (e.g., /sap/bc/adt/oo/classes/zcl_my_class). If not provided, resolved automatically from objectName + objectType via search. For set_api_state: the object whose API release contract to set (or pass name + objectType instead).

oldPackage.description: Current package of the object. Required for change_package.

recordChanges.description: Whether the created package records object changes in transport requests. Defaults to true for non-LOCAL software components or when a transport layer is set; false for literal LOCAL packages.

responsible.description: Person-responsible: an existing ABAP user (XUBNAME, max 12 chars); an email is rejected. Defaults to the connection user; pass explicitly under principal propagation. BTP: auto-resolved from prior creates.

softwareComponent.description: Software component for create_package (default: LOCAL on-prem, ZLOCAL on BTP).

superPackage.description: Parent package for create_package (defaults to empty root package).

tileInstanceId.description: Tile instance ID in the source catalog (required for flp_add_tile_to_group).

title.description: Title — required for flp_create_catalog and flp_create_group.

transport.description: Optional transport request (corrNr) for create_package, delete_package, or change_package.

transportLayer.description: Transport layer for create_package (optional; required by some transportable landscapes).

name: SAPManage
